bodies.name: Board of Trustees of Eagle Mountain-Saginaw ISD

answer.rationale: The recording-specific official agenda explicitly names both the EMSISD Board of Trustees and Fort Worth City Council as the meeting bodies; the provider player corroborates that joint title. The agenda includes call to order, district and city reports, separate board-president and mayor announcements, and adjournment. Assign the whole recording to the configured EMSISD Board joint-meetings feed, whose scope expressly covers these joint proceedings, and to both configured Council feeds, whose descriptions cover Fort Worth City Council meetings. The joint-meetings feed is a publication grouping, not an additional convening body. No evidence identifies this as a Council worksession or another committee's meeting. The opening ceremony and economic-development report are agenda segments, not grounds to exclude or archive the joint meeting.
